[Ricci-flat examples with positive AVR (Remark 27.55)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0053 1. ch27:27.55\group Nonnegative Ricci curvature

There are complete noncompact four-dimensional Ricci-flat (hyper-Kähler and asymptotically locally Euclidean) manifolds with positive AVR.
